extName.message: Watch Later Cleaner & Play Next Queue

extDescription.message: Clean up a huge YouTube Watch Later list with filters and a backup first. Adds "Play next" and a queue of your own.

playNextHint.message: Play next: put first in the queue

addToQueueHint.message: Add to the end of the queue

toastEnd.message: "$1" added to the queue ($2 in total)

queueError.message: Could not change the queue. Reload the page.

autoAdvanceOn.message: next plays when this one ends

popupQueueEmpty.message: The queue is empty. Hover a video thumbnail on YouTube and click "Play next" or "Add to queue" — or right-click a video link.

popupWlText.message: Load the whole list, filter it and remove what you no longer need — with a backup.

panelFoot.message: Everything runs in your browser. Requests go only to YouTube — the same ones the page itself makes.

introText.message: The extension loads the whole list (YouTube shows 100 videos at a time), shows how many are watched, unavailable or Shorts, and lets you choose what to remove. A backup is downloaded before anything is removed.

builtinNote.message: YouTube has its own "Remove watched videos" item (the list's ⋮ menu) — it removes all watched videos at once. Here you can pick the watched threshold, unavailable videos, channels, duration, and preview the list first.

loadStopped.message: Loading stopped: only the first $1 videos are below.

loadPartial.message: Not all videos were loaded ($1, error $2). Filters apply to the loaded ones only.

err_noContext.message: The YouTube page is not ready yet. Wait a few seconds and try again.

err_notLoggedIn.message: Sign in to YouTube: the Watch Later list exists only when you are signed in.

err_loadHttp.message: YouTube did not return the list (error $1). Reload the page and try again.

err_format.message: YouTube seems to have changed the list format and the extension cannot read it. Nothing was removed. Please update the extension.

hiddenHint.message: The YouTube header says $1 videos, $2 were loaded — YouTube may hide some unavailable ones.

f_position.message: Everything except the first in the list:

f_positionKeep.message: How many first videos to keep

manualHint.message: Checkboxes in the list add or exclude single videos on top of the filters.

dryRunHint.message: Go through every step without a single request to YouTube

speedExplain.message: "Careful" — 10 videos every ~3 seconds, "Normal" — 25 every ~1.5 seconds. The first request always carries one video; pauses grow after errors and "too many requests".

safetyNote.message: A backup of the whole list (JSON) is downloaded before removal. Videos are removed in small batches with pauses; you can pause, cancel and continue after a reload.

confirmRemoveBackup.message: A backup of the whole list (JSON) is downloaded first — you can re-add videos from it.

confirmRemoveKeepOpen.message: Keep this tab open while it runs (if you close it, you can continue later).

jobPaused.message: Paused. Continue now or after reloading the page.

jobDone.message: Done: $1 videos removed. Reload the page to see the updated list.

jobDryDone.message: Dry run finished: $1 videos would be removed in $2 requests. Not a single request was sent to YouTube.

jobErr_auth.message: YouTube rejected the request (not signed in or the session expired). Reload the page and continue.

jobErr_rate.message: YouTube asks to slow down ("too many requests"). Paused — continue in a few minutes.

jobErr_network.message: Several requests in a row failed (no network or a YouTube error). Paused.

jobFailedList.message: $1 skipped (YouTube did not accept them — e.g. already removed):

queueSectionHint.message: Instead of removing the selected videos you can watch them in a row: they go to the end of the queue.

restoreExplain.message: Videos marked as removed in the backup are added back. Order and "date added" will differ; unavailable videos cannot be re-added.

restoreCaveat.message: Order and date added will differ; unavailable videos are skipped.

restoreSkipPresent.message: Videos already in the loaded list are skipped.

restoreNotLoaded.message: The list is not loaded, so YouTube will simply skip videos that are already there.

restoreNothing.message: The backup has no videos that can be re-added.

restoreBadFile.message: This is not a backup made by this extension (JSON or CSV expected).

optDesc_hoverButtons.message: "Play next" and "Add to queue" when you hover a thumbnail

opt_autoAdvance.message: Advance to the next queued video

optDesc_autoAdvance.message: When a video ends, open the next one from the queue — even with autoplay off

opt_queuePanel.message: Queue panel on the watch page

optDesc_queuePanel.message: Reorder (drag or arrows), remove and "Next" at hand

storedBackupsExplain.message: A JSON file is downloaded before every removal; the last three backups are also kept here (on this computer only).

deleteBackupsConfirm.message: Delete the backups kept in the extension? Downloaded files stay.

aboutText.message: Free, no account, no ads, no analytics. Open source.

aboutRequests.message: The extension talks to no server except YouTube itself: the list and removals use the same requests the Watch Later page makes, in your tab.
